title: Sparkly bell
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bellGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD94A'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#F5B824'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C98A12'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bellShade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE98A' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#FFD94A' stop-opacity='0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#B87A0E' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g>
    <path d='M20 18 L22.5 25 L29 27.5 L22.5 30 L20 37 L17.5 30 L11 27.5 L17.5 25 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <path d='M82 24 L84 29.5 L89.5 31.5 L84 33.5 L82 39 L80 33.5 L74.5 31.5 L80 29.5 Z' fill='#FFE88A'/>
    <path d='M76 62 L77.5 66 L81.5 67.5 L77.5 69 L76 73 L74.5 69 L70.5 67.5 L74.5 66 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <path d='M24 66 L25.5 70 L29.5 71.5 L25.5 73 L24 77 L22.5 73 L18.5 71.5 L22.5 70 Z' fill='#9BE7FF'/>
    <path d='M50 10 L51.5 14 L55.5 15.5 L51.5 17 L50 21 L48.5 17 L44.5 15.5 L48.5 14 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <path d='M12 45 L13 47.5 L15.5 48.5 L13 49.5 L12 52 L11 49.5 L8.5 48.5 L11 47.5 Z' fill='#FFE88A'/>
    <path d='M88 45 L89 47.5 L91.5 48.5 L89 49.5 L88 52 L87 49.5 L84.5 48.5 L87 47.5 Z' fill='#9BE7FF'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='18' r='2.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='14' r='1.8' fill='#FFE88A'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='38' r='1.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='14' cy='58' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  </g>

  <!-- bell crown / loop -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#E8A81C' stroke-width='4'/>
  <rect x='46' y='32' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#D9941A'/>

  <!-- bell body -->
  <path d='M50 36
           C38 36 32 44 30 58
           C29 64 28 68 27 72
           L73 72
           C72 68 71 64 70 58
           C68 44 62 36 50 36 Z'
        fill='url(#bellGrad)'/>
  <path d='M50 36
           C38 36 32 44 30 58
           C29 64 28 68 27 72
           L73 72
           C72 68 71 64 70 58
           C68 44 62 36 50 36 Z'
        fill='url(#bellShade)'/>

  <!-- highlight -->
  <path d='M44 42 C40 46 38 54 37 62 L41 62 C42 54 44 47 47 43 Z' fill='#FFF6C4' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- rim of bell -->
  <rect x='24' y='71' width='52' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#D9941A'/>
  <rect x='24' y='71' width='52' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFE98A'/>

  <!-- clapper -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='83' r='6' fill='#B87A0E'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='81' r='2' fill='#FFD94A'/>
</svg>
